node.title: Re: modern perl 1.0
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I need to do some archeology and get the source of perl 1.0. Preferably modified to compile on a modern platform.

That's all part of the official Perl repository at [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commits/maint-1.0].

Update: See also [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl1.porters/] and [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2002/12/msg69958.html|Perl 1.0.15 released] on P5P.
